0022600215.text: The Orlando Magic (2-7, 12th in the East, 4 games back in the Southeast, on a four-game losing streak) visit the Sacramento Kings (1-8, 15th in the West, on a two-game losing streak) for Orlando's 10th game of the season. Orlando is missing Paolo Banchero, Jalen Suggs, Izaiyah Nelson, Jonathan Isaac and Noah Penda, and Desmond Bane is day-to-day with an illness and a game-time decision, while Sacramento is without Ben Simmons, Domantas Sabonis and Maxime Raynaud. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Magic won both games against the Kings in 2025-26, including a 121-117 win in Orlando on March 26, 2026.
